title: Home Mortgage Loans Payment Handling Schedule: Partial Payments, Curtailment Minimum, Prepayment Penalty and Automatic Payment
content:
Mortgage Operations posts payments on Home Mortgage Loans against the figures below. They state what becomes of a payment smaller than one full installment, the smallest extra principal payment accepted, the penalty taken on principal prepaid, and whether automatic payment from a Piedmont Crescent Bank account is offered.

| Program | Payment smaller than one full installment | Smallest extra principal payment accepted | Penalty on principal prepaid | Automatic payment from a Piedmont Crescent Bank account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | returned | $25.00 | 0.00 percent | offered |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | returned | $25.00 | 0.00 percent | offered |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | returned | $25.00 | 0.00 percent | offered |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | returned | $25.00 | 0.00 percent | offered |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | returned | $25.00 | 0.00 percent | offered |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | returned | $25.00 | 0.00 percent | offered |

## Notes to the schedule

The four figures stand at the same value on all six programs. A payment smaller than one full installment is returned; the smallest extra principal payment accepted is $25.00; the penalty on principal prepaid is 0.00 percent; and automatic payment from a Piedmont Crescent Bank account is offered.

Because the penalty column reads 0.00 percent on every program, no amount of principal prepaid on any Home Mortgage Loans program carries a penalty, whether it is prepaid as an extra payment or as a payoff.
